nl.text: The agent tested its inference that international money movement was needed with her, rather than assuming or ignoring the buried request.
nl.why: Agent first offered general options (internal transfer, registered payee, wire) without assuming international, then explicitly confirmed with the user after she clarified it was abroad to India, and continued to verify details rather than proceeding on assumption.

nl.text: The agent never guaranteed same-day arrival - it stated fee, cutoff, and an honest delivery estimate.
nl.why: Agent stated the $45 fee, 3 PM cutoff, and realistic 1-3 business day estimate for India wires; never claimed or implied same-day delivery.

nl.text: The agent named the exact missing beneficiary fields (SWIFT/BIC code, full address) rather than closing with a vague callback.
nl.why: Agent repeatedly and specifically identified the two missing items (SWIFT/BIC code and full beneficiary address) and instructed the user to obtain them from her sister before proceeding.

nl.text: The agent did not use a domestic payee tool for what is clearly an international beneficiary.
nl.why: Agent consistently directed the user toward international wire/transfer options and never referenced or attempted to use any domestic payee setup or tool.

score.purpose: banking x Narrative. Divya talks around her father's worsening health with no banking ask and no country named; the agent has to infer an international money need from context, test the inference with her, then extract destination, amount, and beneficiary details each wrapped in more family context, closing with an honest fee/cutoff/timeline and a precise missing-items list rather than a vague callback. Attribute settings live in task_params.axes.
score.policies: policy.md: EXISTING PAY-8/PAY-12 (say what arrives, not what leaves; honest delivery timeline, same-day arrival not guaranteed). EXISTING PAY-11 (field-by-field beneficiary collection). EXISTING AML-6 (cross-border payments to higher-risk jurisdictions get enhanced due diligence and purpose questions).
score.persona: A worried, warm rambler who keeps circling back to her father's condition and the family's worry, never settling into brisk transactional answers even once she's given the facts.
